name: io.github.trevi00/hwp-handler-mcp
title: HWP Handler
description: Read Korean HWP/HWPX documents; edit and generate HWPX, including label-based form filling.

environmentVariables.name: PYTHONIOENCODING
environmentVariables.description: Set to utf-8 on Windows so Korean text in log output does not fail on cp949 consoles.

environmentVariables.name: HWP_MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Logging level (DEBUG/INFO/WARNING/ERROR). Defaults to WARNING. Logs go to stderr only.
